title: Exponential bound for a singleton expression
statement: For all nonnegative integers $n,C,Q$, let $a=8(C+1)(Q+1)+1$ and $b=(8(C+1)(Q+1))^4+8a+4$. Then $(8(C+1)(Q+1))^4(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1)^4 9^{2a(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1)}\leq2^{b(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1)}$.
